entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 3380479015342121600: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 32.1855 +/- 0.0242 mas (same row, RUWE 1.00): 31.07 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -35.839, -96.668 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 1.146 +/- 0.026 solar radii from Liu et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 50554 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...72L/abstract). Mass 1.04 +/- 0.05 solar masses from Liu et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HD 50554 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...72L/abstract). Temperature 5968 +/- 96 K from Liu et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 50554 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,968 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: HD 50554 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #fff3f0. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: HD 50554 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,968 K and log g 4.34 (u1 0.420, u2 0.283): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
